key_insight: TAT-Det provides expert-annotated ultrasound images to support AI detection and segmentation of testicular appendage torsion.
clinical_relevance: The dataset supports research on a leading cause of acute scrotal pain in prepubertal children, where diagnosis can be challenging.
method: Collected 2,600 ultrasound images from 1,203 patients at one children's hospital.
Annotated TAT-positive images with lesion bounding boxes and pixel-level segmentation masks.
Used independent expert annotation, consensus review, and refinement; benchmarked detection and segmentation models.
evidence_signal: Among the benchmarked models, YOLO11m performed best for detection and RWKV-UNet for segmentation; the abstract reports no numerical performance metrics.
watch_item: Single-center data may limit generalizability; performance across other hospitals and ultrasound systems needs evaluation.
paper_title: TAT-Det: A Dataset for Testicular Appendage Torsion Detection and Segmentation in Ultrasound Images
